“A legacy of generic personal property shall be valid ONLY if there be PERSONAL PROPERTY of ITS kind in the estate”¦”

rows.abstract:
Intends to preserve and protect the principle of separation of powers among the executive branches of the government for them to be effective in the discharge of their functions.

Seeks to provide an EXCEPTION to the imposition of preventive suspension to an incumbent public officer, EXCEPT OFFICERS WHO MAY BE REMOVED ONLY BY IMPEACHMENT; MEMBERS OF CONGRESS; AND MEMBERS OF THE SUPREME COURT AND COURT OF APPEALS against whom any criminal prosecution under valid information under the provisions of the Penal Code on bribery is pending in court.

rows.author: H056
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROMOTING INTEGRATED URBAN AGRICULTURE IN URBAN AREAS NATIONWIDE TO ADDRESS FOOD SECURITY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Aims to promote and protect the fundamental right of every person to adequate food and freedom from hunger, optimize the use and productivity of urban land resources and spaces to support sufficient and sustainable food production, and develop modern-cost effective, space-efficient, and environmentally-safe agriculture technologies in urban areas to contribute in achieving sustainable food production and food security.

Seeks to promote integrated urban agriculture development in all metropolitan areas nationwide which shall cover idle or abandoned government or private lands, buildings, shipping containers, subdivisions or villages, public housing, open spaces in all urban, peri-urban and urbanizable areas in the country, and all available land resources and buildings in schools, state or private universities and colleges, military camps suitable for growing crops and raising poultry, livestock and aquaculture.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2021-02-02, transmitted to the Senate on 2021-02-03 and received by the Senate on 2021-02-03
